knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Scratches hold soil, so the surface becomes harder to clean over time.
Strength increases are not authorised by the cleaner. Record and escalate.
Drips can contaminate food and enter electrical controls.

practicalCriteria: Selects a compatible method for four surfaces and three soil types.
Completes one degreasing sequence with no damage to the finish.
Protects food and controls from drips throughout.
passRule: Correct method for all surfaces, no damage to the finish in the practical, and drips controlled. Observed by an assessor.
stopWorkCriteria: Product used on a surface it is not approved for
Drips reaching an electrical control or food
